correct_text:
Request for Comments: 8808
Updates: 8342
Category: Standards Track
ISSN: 2070-1721
notes:
RFC 8808 Section 3 formally defines the "Factory-Default" datastore, and the YANG in Section 4 
shows the identity "factory-default" extending the base identity "ds:datastore", which is defined in 
RFC 8342.  Thus, it seems accurate that RFC 8808 updates RFC8342.

Currently, due to RFC 8342 not having the "Updated by" line, it seems many NMDA
implementations are unaware that the <factory-default> datastore exists, and hence the NMDA
solution appears lacking.

It would be good if the RFC Editor could update the metadata about both documents.
